description: Run DeepSeek Harness (dsh) threads in bb over ACP, with Standard, Creator, and Minimal modes chosen in the New thread composer, a read-only badge naming the mode a thread booted with, a live roster of the dsh subagents a thread deploys, harness slash commands exposed to the agent, and one-command provisioning of the dsh profiles, run_command plugin, and ACP bridge patch. Requires dsh installed globally and a model credential for its route.
